New policy-dialog unit tests first needed the normal jsdom native dialog polyfill; genuine feature RED was then reproduced with the props absent.
Auth restoration regression exposed the existing owner publishing its event before verified-cookie assignment; one microtask checks the same owner after synchronous publication.
HTTP408 originally cleared pending policy identity; genuine RED now passes with408/429/5xx retaining the original request.

integrationHandoff.sourcePrivacy: No invented legacy SymposiumProvenance, provider identity, timestamp, completed cursor, execution capability or send receipt.
integrationHandoff.coreCallSites: Core mounts useConversationPresentation and CollaborationTranscript through existing pages/auth/session owners; actual execution/queue/Stop/send and reader delivery remain core. No A API.send or execution enablement.
integrationHandoff.drafts: Optional ChatDraft.settings.collaborationResponders={collaborationId,responders} in existing draft schema/key/version. Blank drafts retain explicit intent; consumption equality protects changed settings. Foreign-group intent is refused, unchanged timestamp notifications keep stable semantic draft references.
integrationHandoff.history: The protocol retains at most 50 messages in a view. Earlier-message availability is disclosed; no invented older-page endpoint.
integrationHandoff.messageActions: ChatArea display ID is projectionId; share/action owners must resolve it to the actual CollaborationMessage messageId/source before forwarding. B and core notified.
integrationHandoff.controller: useConversationPresentation({collaborationId,api,authScope,getVerifiedAuthScope,draftId,names}) reuses existing real typed view/events/setPolicy, projection and ordinary draft owner. Core supplies its existing currentVerifiedAuthSessionId getter; missing or mismatched current proof fails closed. AUTH_LOST clears private state and fences late results; restore checks after existing auth owner synchronous publication.
integrationHandoff.policy: Confirmed server view drives checkboxes. In-memory pending request retains requestId, membership/revision fences and values on network/408/429/5xx ambiguity. retryPolicy reuses exact original body. Unchanged read cannot clear uncertainty; newer authoritative revision fences it. Known definite400/401/403/404/409/422 refusal clears pending but retains error until refresh. No optimistic success.
integrationHandoff.agentsSlots: ConversationAgents adds optional policyFeedback:ReactNode and policyUnavailableReason:string; feedback appears once inside existing Agents dialog. Core wires pending/refusal/retry/refresh via these slots. No new joining lifecycle or auth owner.
integrationHandoff.header: Core df7aaa markup is integrated as93ab42f6 and extended by A container/count corrections a24bd063+844d5ddb. Consume final A once; do not independently reapply core header patch.
